title: Implement CodeActAgent class
description: Implement src/codeact_agent/agent.py with the CodeActAgent class. The class must have: __init__(self, model: str, api_key: str, base_url: str) which creates an async OpenAI client (OpenAI(api_key=api_key, base_url=base_url)) and an agents.Agent instance with a detailed CodeAct system prompt. The system prompt must instruct the agent to: use Python as its action space, respond with markdown fenced code blocks, leverage persistent namespace, use stdout/stderr feedback for debugging, and respond with text (no code) when done. The async run(self, history: list[dict[str, str]]) -> str method must use agents.Runner.run() to send the conversation history and return the response text. All public methods must have type hints and docstrings.
acceptance_criteria: CodeActAgent class is defined with correct __init__ signature
System prompt contains required phrases: 'Python', 'code block', 'stdout', 'stderr', 'persist'
run() method is async and returns str
All public methods have type hints and docstrings
Module passes ruff check and ruff format

title: Implement PythonSandbox execution engine
description: Implement src/codeact_agent/sandbox.py with two components: (1) SandboxResult - a Pydantic model with fields: stdout (str), stderr (str), exception (str | None), return_value (object | None). (2) PythonSandbox class with __init__ (initializes empty dict namespace), async execute(self, code: str) -> SandboxResult (executes code via exec() in the namespace dict, capturing stdout/stderr via io.StringIO redirect of sys.stdout/sys.stderr, capturing exceptions via traceback.format_exc(), and restoring streams in a finally block), reset(self) (clears the namespace dict), and namespace property (read access to namespace). All public methods must have type hints and docstrings.
acceptance_criteria: SandboxResult Pydantic model has correct fields with type hints
PythonSandbox.execute() captures stdout from print() statements
PythonSandbox.execute() captures stderr writes
PythonSandbox.execute() captures full traceback on exception
Namespace persists across multiple execute() calls
reset() clears the namespace
Stdout/stderr are fully restored after execute() even on exception
All public methods have type hints and docstrings
Module passes ruff check and ruff format

title: Implement AgentLoop
description: Implement src/codeact_agent/loop.py with: (1) Module-level helper extract_code_blocks(text: str) -> list[str] using regex pattern r'```python\s*\n(.*?)```' with re.DOTALL flag to extract Python code blocks from markdown. (2) AgentLoop class with __init__(self, agent: CodeActAgent, sandbox: PythonSandbox, max_turns: int = 20), async run_turn(self, history: list[dict[str, str]]) -> tuple[str, list[dict[str, str]]], and reset(self). The run_turn method implements the self-debug loop: call agent.run(history), extract code blocks, for each block execute via sandbox, format observation (stdout/stderr/exception) as user-role XML-tagged message, append to history, loop until no code blocks or max_turns reached. Returns (final_response, updated_history). All public methods must have type hints and docstrings.
acceptance_criteria: extract_code_blocks() correctly extracts single and multiple code blocks from markdown text
extract_code_blocks() returns empty list when no code blocks present
AgentLoop.run_turn() handles single-turn execution (code -> observation -> response)

AgentLoop.run_turn() stops at max_turns and returns last response
AgentLoop.run_turn() appends observations as user-role messages to history
reset() delegates to sandbox.reset()
All public methods have type hints and docstrings
Module passes ruff check and ruff format

title: Implement CLI REPL (main.py)
description: Implement src/codeact_agent/main.py as the CLI entry point. Use click.command() with options --model (envvar CODEACT_MODEL, default 'openrouter/anthropic/claude-sonnet-4'), --api-key (envvar OPENROUTER_API_KEY), --base-url (envvar OPENAI_API_BASE, default 'https://openrouter.ai/api/v1'). The main() function: (1) Load .env via python_dotenv.load_dotenv(). (2) Validate that api_key is set, print error and exit if not. (3) Print startup banner with model, provider, Python version, available slash commands. (4) Initialize CodeActAgent, PythonSandbox, AgentLoop. (5) Run REPL loop: read input with prompt 'codeact> ', check slash commands (/help prints commands, /reset clears history and sandbox, /history shows turn count and model, /exit /quit prints session summary and exits), otherwise run agent_loop.run_turn(history) via anyio.run() bridge, display results with Rich (reasoning text with dim style, code blocks with Syntax(code, 'python', theme='monokai'), stdout in green Panel, stderr/exception in red Panel). (6) On exit print session summary (turns, model). All functions must have type hints and docstrings.
